---
title: "References"
---

The book's tidyverse approach draws on *R for Data Science*
[@wickham2023r4ds], its visualization teaching draws on the third edition of
*ggplot2: Elegant Graphics for Data Analysis* [@wickham2026ggplot2], and the
text-analysis case follows the tidy text framework [@silge2017textmining].

The main investment data come from Norges Bank Investment Management
[@nbim2026investments], while the employment case uses data published by Hong
Kong's University Grants Committee [@hkgov2026employment]. The website and book
publishing guidance refers to the official Quarto documentation
[@quarto2026docs].

::: {#refs}
